title: Canonical Format: Page Takeover
description: Coordinated ownership of multiple placements sold as one buy. Each component either declares an inline non-custom, non-takeover canonical format or references a sibling format option on the same product. Components cannot nest page takeovers. The creative manifest supplies each component's canonical slots under `component_assets.<component_id>` so repeated slot names cannot collide; `shared_slots` assets are supplied once in top-level `assets` and injected only into compatible consuming components. Semantic validators resolve sibling references, validate component params and required assets against their canonical schemas, enforce unique component IDs, and validate shared-slot consumers and types.

experimental.description: Experimental in AdCP 3.2 while the creative working group gathers implementation evidence for cross-placement composition and exclusivity.

v1_translatable.description: No v1 named-format equivalent can express a coordinated multi-placement buy.

component_id.description: Stable takeover-local component identifier. Values MUST be unique within `components[]`.

placement_role.description: Seller-defined semantic placement role, such as `masthead`, `skin`, or `preroll`.

canvas_constraints.description: Artwork constraints applied to this component, including safe areas and seller-reserved regions.

format_option_ref.description: Reference to a sibling `format_options[]` entry on the same product. It MUST NOT resolve to `custom` or `page_takeover`.

shared_slots.description: Manifest slots supplied once and consumed by one or more takeover components.

consumed_by.description: Component IDs that consume this shared asset. Every value MUST resolve to `components[].component_id`.

exclusivity.description: `named_slots` reserves only the declared components; `all_slots` is roadblock semantics for every eligible slot in the takeover scope.

verifier_constraints.format_option_ref_resolution: component references resolve only against sibling format_options entries on the same product
verifier_constraints.component_kind: resolved and inline components cannot be custom or page_takeover
verifier_constraints.inline_params: inline params validate against the schema selected by inline format_kind
verifier_constraints.component_assets: required components have a component_assets entry satisfying their resolved canonical slots
verifier_constraints.shared_slot_consumers: every shared_slots[].consumed_by value resolves to a declared component_id whose canonical slots accept the shared asset_group_id and asset_type
